short.en: An exchange semester at a Berlin university combined with real volunteering inside one of Germany's oldest youth-work NGOs. Three funding tiers, from Full Scholarship to Partial. Requires citizenship of one of 21 eligible countries, enrolment in a Bachelor's, Master's or Doctorate programme, age under 28 at the start, and B1+ in German or English.
short.ru: Учебный семестр в берлинском вузе плюс настоящее волонтёрство в одной из старейших молодёжных НКО Германии. Три уровня финансирования — от полной стипендии до частичной. Нужно гражданство одной из 21 страны, учёба на бакалавриате, магистратуре или в аспирантуре, возраст до 28 на момент старта и B1+ немецкого или английского.

ies.full:
The scholarship program in Berlin offers much more than studying at a good university. It gives you the chance to empower yourself through real volunteering in one of the oldest and largest youth-working NGOs in Germany. By joining our daily work, you support projects, help at events, assist international activities, and contribute to the growth of our community.

Volunteering lets you experience German culture from the inside. You take part in cultural events, community activities, and teamwork that helps you build friendships and truly feel part of Berlin.

Our program is not passive. Every scholarship holder shapes their own path. Your ideas and energy influence the projects you join. Mentors support you in the first weeks, give practical advice, and help you settle into your new life.

FUNDING OPTIONS

Full Scholarship
• Monthly pocket money
• Health insurance reimbursed
• Accommodation, enrollment, liability insurance, educational trips, social meetings, administration, welcome package, cultural events, international seminars, consulting, mentoring and workshops covered directly
• Travel expenses not covered

Partial Scholarship PLUS
• Monthly pocket money
• Accommodation, enrollment, liability insurance and the full programme covered directly
• Travel and health insurance not covered

Partial Scholarship
• Monthly pocket money
• Enrollment, liability insurance and the full programme covered directly
• Travel and health insurance not covered
• Two months of accommodation (1,650 EUR) paid by the participant, the rest covered

REQUIREMENTS
• Student in one of: Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, China, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Kosovo, Moldova, Mongolia, Montenegro, Northern Macedonia, Russia, Serbia, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Turkey, Ukraine, Uzbekistan
• Bachelor, Master or Doctorate student at the time of starting
• Not older than 28 at the time of starting
• All fields of study
• German or English at least B1

short.en: Young people from Armenia and Georgia build digital peacebuilding prototypes in mixed teams. Prototype sprints instead of lectures, mentorship, and a final pitch. Accommodation and all meals fully covered; travel handled by sending organisations. Working language English. Requires taking part in both preparatory Innovation Labs in Tbilisi and Yerevan.
short.ru: Молодёжь из Армении и Грузии создаёт цифровые прототипы для миростроительства в смешанных командах. Вместо лекций — спринты прототипирования, менторство и финальный питч. Проживание и питание полностью покрыты, дорогу организуют отправляющие организации. Рабочий язык — английский. Обязательно участие в подготовительных Innovation Labs в Тбилиси и Ереване.

bootcamp.full:
This bootcamp brings together young people from Armenia and Georgia to develop cross-border digital peacebuilding solutions through a hands-on innovation process. Rather than traditional lectures, participants work in mixed international teams to identify community challenges, design and test digital-peace prototypes, receive mentorship, and present their solutions at the end of the programme.

OBJECTIVES
• Strengthen digital collaboration and prototype-development skills in mixed Armenian-Georgian teams
• Apply peacebuilding and conflict-sensitive approaches to real community challenges
• Develop digital-peace prototypes suitable for further mentoring and policy dialogue
• Promote intercultural teamwork, peer learning and cross-border cooperation
• Support reflection through the Youthpass framework

METHODS
Non-formal education, experiential learning, prototype sprints, peer feedback, digital collaboration tools, mentoring sessions, daily reflection, testing and validation exercises, pitch coaching.

OUTPUTS
A digital-peace prototype per team, prototype summary sheets, daily reflection logs, pitch decks and final presentations, Youthpass certificate.

LOGISTICS
Working language: English.
Arrival 8 October 2026, departure 15 October 2026. Extra days are at the participant's own expense.
Accommodation fully covered: shared apartment-style rooms at First Flatotel International in Benalmadena-Costa, mixed by country to encourage exchange.
All-inclusive catering throughout, including dinner on arrival day and breakfast on departure day. Dietary requirements accommodated if communicated in advance.
Travel arrangements and reimbursement are managed by the sending organisations. Keep all tickets, boarding passes, invoices and receipts. Recommended airport: Malaga-Costa del Sol (AGP).

MANDATORY PREPARATORY LABS
Participation in both Innovation Labs is required:
• Tbilisi, Georgia: 5-9 August 2026
• Yerevan, Armenia: 9-13 August 2026
Transport for Armenian participants between Yerevan and Tbilisi is organised by car. Accommodation and meals in Tbilisi are fully provided for them; in Yerevan meals are provided and accommodation is self-arranged.

Partner: Copernicus Yerevan, Armenia.

short.en: The premium alumni track for former IES participants ready to move from participant to community builder. You mentor the next cohort, support onboarding, and turn your specialisation into visible deliverables. Full funding: accommodation, insurance, activities, mentoring, workshops and monthly pocket money; health insurance reimbursed.
short.ru: Премиальный трек для выпускников IES, готовых перейти из участника в того, кто строит сообщество. Ты менторишь новый набор, помогаешь с онбордингом и превращаешь свою специализацию в измеримый результат. Полное финансирование: проживание, страховка, активности, менторство, воркшопы и ежемесячные выплаты, медстраховка возмещается.

pir.full:
The Professional in Residence (PiR) Scholarship is Copernicus Berlin's premium alumni track tailored for former International Excellence Scholarship (IES) participants who are ready to take the next step from being a participant to becoming a community builder. Designed for individuals already familiar with the culture, values and standards of Copernicus Berlin, PiR offers a structured framework for growth into leadership roles where you can mentor, support and guide the next cohort of scholars.

As a PiR scholar, you don't simply join a program - you actively shape the scholarship community. You will be entrusted with real responsibilities that influence the quality and success of the IES experience, including supporting onboarding, ensuring smooth integration, and strengthening a culture of respect, discipline and collaboration among scholarship holders. This role allows your unique specialization - such as IT, media, design, training, project development, communications, research or operations - to become a driver of tangible impact.

One of the key distinctions of PiR is its emphasis on outcomes that build your professional profile. Beyond mentorship and community support, your contributions result in visible deliverables, collaborative achievements and leadership experience that can be showcased in a professional portfolio. PiR is conceived as a bridge between the IES experience and long-term involvement in international projects, civic innovation and European cooperation networks.

FUNDING
Full funding covering accommodation, liability insurance, cultural and educational activities, mentoring, workshops, administration and a monthly pocket money stipend. Health insurance is reimbursed. Travel costs are not covered.

short.en: A rolling internship programme with no age limit, open to applicants from all countries and all occupations. Minimum two weeks, application period about one month. You shape the content around your own preferences. Accommodation on the Copernicus Berlin Campus in the city centre. Requires English or German at B1+.
short.ru: Постоянная программа стажировок без возрастных ограничений, открытая для любых стран и профессий. Минимум две недели, приём заявок около месяца. Содержание подстраиваешь под себя. Проживание в кампусе Copernicus Berlin в центре города. Нужен английский или немецкий на B1+.

leaders.full:
ONGOING Internship Program LEADERS for FUTURE takes place on an ongoing basis. The minimum duration of the program is two weeks. The application period is approximately one month.

Ongoing LF is a unique opportunity to tailor your experience according to your flexibility and content preferences. Regardless of age, background, or current employment status, this program welcomes everyone. Whether you are a motivated high school student looking to gain real-world experience, a university student seeking to expand your horizons, or someone currently employed or seeking employment, the programme offers a diverse and inclusive environment.

WHAT YOU GET
Travel - explore Germany's architecture, culture and language firsthand, plus the chance to discover other European destinations.
Language - enhance your German and English through organised courses.
Networking - new friendships, professional networks and collaborations.
Experience - unique work experience in Germany, professional and social skills.

REQUIREMENTS
• No age restriction
• Applicants from all countries welcome
• All occupations welcome
• Good knowledge of English or German (at least B1)
• Motivated, independent and responsible

ACCOMMODATION
Furnished apartments at the Copernicus Berlin Campus, centrally located, single and double rooms, high-speed internet, cable television and an on-campus laundry service.

The campus sits in the centre of Berlin near Alexanderplatz, Berlin Cathedral, Museum Island, East Side Gallery, Warschauer Strasse and Oberbaumbruecke, with parks, sports facilities, shopping, supermarkets, pharmacies and gyms nearby, and good bus, subway and suburban train connections.

short.en: Short-term educational stays in Berlin for students and professionals from any country: conferences, hackathons, academic events, workshops or an individual learning plan. Up to ten weeks, centrally located apartments, official invitation letters for educational purposes. Priced from 980 EUR for two weeks to 4,180 EUR for ten.
short.ru: Короткие образовательные поездки в Берлин для студентов и специалистов из любых стран: конференции, хакатоны, академические события, воркшопы или индивидуальный учебный план. До десяти недель, квартиры в центре, официальные приглашения для образовательных целей. Стоимость от 980 EUR за две недели до 4 180 EUR за десять.

edu_tourism.full:
Educational Tourism with Copernicus Berlin provides students and professionals from all countries with the opportunity to visit Berlin for short-term educational purposes. The program supports individuals who wish to attend conferences, hackathons, academic events, cultural programs or Copernicus Berlin workshops, as well as those who wish to pursue an individual learning plan.

Participants may stay for a variable period of up to ten weeks. Each stay is based on an individual educational plan, reviewed and discussed with the participant.

ACCOMMODATION
Centrally located apartments in Berlin - private or shared with other members of the Copernicus Berlin community. All apartments are safe, fully furnished and close to public transport, cultural landmarks and educational institutions.

VISA SUPPORT
Official invitation letters for educational purposes, confirming the learning plan, purpose of stay, accommodation details and participation in optional workshops or excursions. General guidance is offered; full visa-accompaniment is not included.

LEARNING PLAN REVIEW
Each participant submits an educational plan. Copernicus Berlin reviews it, provides feedback and helps structure it according to German requirements for short-term educational travel.

WORKSHOPS AND EXCURSIONS
Optional cultural visits, thematic educational sessions and skill-based workshops, which can be included in the invitation letter if relevant to the learning plan.

PRICING
2 weeks - 980 EUR
4 weeks - 1,780 EUR
6 weeks - 2,580 EUR
8 weeks - 3,380 EUR
10 weeks - 4,180 EUR

ELIGIBILITY
Open to students and young professionals from all academic fields and countries. Applications are reviewed to ensure a genuine educational purpose; only realistic and well-defined plans are accepted.

short.en: Volunteer at the Berlin campus in IT, design, social media or youth work - other backgrounds welcome too. You get an apartment on the city-centre campus, international events, travel opportunities representing Copernicus Berlin, mentorship, a strong network and a certificate. Apply with a CV via the CAMPUS platform.
short.ru: Волонтёрство в берлинском кампусе по направлениям IT, дизайн, соцсети или работа с молодёжью — другие профили тоже приветствуются. Дают квартиру в кампусе в центре города, международные события, поездки от имени Copernicus Berlin, менторство, сильную сеть контактов и сертификат. Заявка с резюме через платформу CAMPUS.

berlin_volunteering.full:
Volunteering is one of the strongest drivers of personal and professional growth - and at Copernicus Berlin, this experience becomes even more meaningful. Beyond contributing to real impact, you gain skills, connections and opportunities.

AREAS WE ARE LOOKING FOR
IT specialists for web development, database work, system maintenance, cybersecurity basics and improvements to digital platforms. Designers and artists for visual materials, illustrations, branding, layouts and creative content. Social media professionals to manage channels and prepare engaging posts. Youth workers to support trainings, workshops and participant engagement. Motivated people from other fields are equally welcome - initiative and motivation matter most.

HOW TO GET INVOLVED
1. Prepare a chronological CV with education, work experience and relevant skills (a CV builder is available at copernicusberlin.org/cv)
2. Specify the estimated duration of your commitment
3. Choose your start date
4. Fill out the application form on the CAMPUS platform

WHAT AWAITS YOU
• Accommodation in an apartment on the Copernicus Berlin campus in the city centre
• Participation in international events with people from many countries
• Travel opportunities representing Copernicus Berlin abroad
• Personal and professional development through real tasks and mentorship
• A network of professionals, activists and partners across Europe
• A CV boost and improved communication, teamwork, leadership and problem-solving skills
• An official certificate of completion

short.en: Copernicus Yerevan is looking for volunteers in fundraising and grant writing, social media content creation, and event support - and is open to other backgrounds. You get hands-on NGO experience, access to national and international mobility projects, mentorship, a network across Armenia and Europe, and an official certificate.
short.ru: Copernicus Yerevan ищет волонтёров в фандрайзинг и написание грантов, создание контента для соцсетей и поддержку мероприятий — другие профили тоже рассматривают. Даёт практический опыт в НКО, доступ к национальным и международным проектам мобильности, менторство, сеть контактов в Армении и Европе и официальный сертификат.

yerevan_volunteering.full:
At Copernicus Yerevan, we welcome motivated volunteers who want to contribute to our growing international work and strengthen youth opportunities in Armenia and beyond.

AREAS WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Fundraising and grant writing - identifying funding opportunities, researching donors and calls for proposals, assisting with project writing and preparing strong grant applications. A good fit for those interested in international cooperation, NGO development, project design and strategic communication.

Social media content creation - writing captions, creating visuals, preparing stories and reels, taking photos or videos during activities, and communicating our mission and impact to wider audiences.

Event support - preparing and running events, trainings, workshops and community activities: participant communication, logistics, registration, on-site coordination, materials, documentation.

We are equally open to motivated individuals from other backgrounds. Your motivation, reliability and willingness to learn are what matter most.

WHAT AWAITS YOU
• Meaningful involvement in youth, education and international cooperation projects
• Practical experience in fundraising, communication, project development and event organisation
• The possibility to take part in selected national and international projects, exchanges and trainings
• Personal and professional development through real responsibilities and mentorship
• A network of active young people, professionals, trainers and partners from Armenia and Europe
• New competencies for your future studies and career
• A CV boost and improved communication, teamwork, creativity and problem-solving skills
• An official certificate recognising your contribution

short.en: Copernicus Berlin Network is hiring an experienced Grant Writer to find calls, check eligibility and write full applications with the executive team. Freelance, no fixed salary: fee agreed per application and paid for approved projects. After five successful grants, a permanent position is offered in one of the network locations.
short.ru: Copernicus Berlin Network ищет опытного специалиста по грантам: искать конкурсы, проверять соответствие критериям и писать заявки целиком вместе с руководством. Фриланс без фиксированной зарплаты — гонорар согласуется по каждой заявке и выплачивается за одобренные проекты. После пяти успешных грантов предлагают постоянную позицию в одном из офисов сети.

grants_writer.full:
Organisation: Copernicus Berlin Network
Contract type: Freelance / Honorar-based
Location: Remote, with possible cooperation across Berlin, Yerevan, Reunion Island, Chisinau, Sevilla and Naples

Copernicus Berlin is looking for a motivated and experienced Grant Writer to support the wider network in identifying, preparing and submitting strong funding applications. The position suits someone who understands public and private funding, works independently, and can translate ideas into convincing project concepts.

MAIN DUTIES
• Search for suitable grant calls, public funding programmes, private foundations and sponsorship opportunities
• Check eligibility criteria for Copernicus Berlin and its network organisations
• Analyse funding guidelines, priorities, deadlines and application procedures
• Prepare project concepts in regular exchange with the executive team
• Write complete grant applications independently, including objectives, activities, expected results, impact, dissemination and sustainability
• Track deadlines and ensure timely submission
• Suggest visibility materials, portfolio assets, references and statistics that strengthen applications
• Maintain records of submitted applications, deadlines, feedback and results

REQUIREMENTS
• Proven experience in grant writing, project development or fundraising
• Good understanding of EU funding, public grants, private foundations or international donor programmes
• Strong writing skills in English; German or other languages an advantage
• Ability to work independently and meet strict deadlines
• Experience in youth work, education, non-formal learning, civil society, international cooperation, Erasmus+, inclusion, digitalisation, democracy, sustainability or migration projects is an advantage

COOPERATION MODEL
No fixed salary. Freelance / Honorar contract. For each application the remuneration is agreed individually in advance and processed for every successfully approved project. After five successful grants, Copernicus Berlin offers a permanent position with the possibility to work in Berlin, Yerevan, Reunion Island, Chisinau, Sevilla, Naples or London.

HOW TO APPLY
Send your CV, a short cover letter (max 250 words) and, if available, a list of successful approved grants with a very short description of each.
